roadmap.title: Apocalypseburg opening
roadmap.description: Play the story through Apocalypseburg, open your first chest, relic and shop, and try a build attack as the story introduces them.

roadmap.title: Syspocalypstar and the Asteroid Field
roadmap.description: Finish the Syspocalypstar tutorial and the Asteroid Field, then use Syspocalypstar to place builds and try an invalid placement.

roadmap.title: Systarian Jungle
roadmap.description: Finish the jungle level and defeat its boss.

roadmap.title: Harmony City
roadmap.description: Finish the Harmony City story level.

roadmap.title: Sorting Area
roadmap.description: Finish the Sorting Area story level and defeat its boss.

roadmap.title: The Ceremony and the story ending
roadmap.description: Finish The Ceremony to complete the main story.

roadmap.title: Bonus worlds
roadmap.description: Visit the five bonus planets, finish each story and gather their Master Pieces with the tools you now own.

roadmap.title: Clean-up and 100%
roadmap.description: Return to the story worlds for their Master Pieces, then build, collect relics, items, characters and studs, and visit Goldtropolis after 400 Master Pieces for the 100% total.

steps.text: Follow the yellow star markers through the @loc{Apocalypseburg} story until the level ends.
Reach the end of the @loc{Apocalypseburg} story and defeat the @enemy{Alien Giraffe}.

achievements.description: Collect All Master Pieces on Apocalypseburg
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in Apocalypseburg, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Apocalypseburg} holds about 50 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 9 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Apocalypseburg}.
Walk around @loc{Apocalypseburg} for the 23 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 18 quest pieces.
Return with @item{Danger Fists} for green-flecked boulders and bars, @item{Jet Wings} for the crane mesa, and @item{Super Wings} or a flying vehicle for the thin skyscraper and the airship race.

achievements.displayName: Mind if I save your life?
achievements.summary: Finish the Asteroid Field story level.

steps.text: Follow the yellow star markers through the @loc{Asteroid Field} story until the level ends.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces in the Asteroid Field
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in the Asteroid Field, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Asteroid Field} holds about 50 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 5 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Asteroid Field}.
Walk around @loc{Asteroid Field} for the 24 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 21 quest pieces.
Return with the @item{Jet Wings}, @item{Grapple Gun}, @item{Camera}, @item{Welding Tool}, @item{Tractor Beam} and a flying vehicle for the quests that need them.

achievements.displayName: Student has become the teaching assistant
achievements.summary: Finish the Systarian Jungle story level.

steps.text: Follow the yellow star markers through the @loc{Systarian Jungle} story until the level ends.
Play the @loc{Systarian Jungle} story to its end and defeat the boss.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces in the Systarian Jungle
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in the Systarian Jungle, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Systarian Jungle} holds about 50 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 10 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Systarian Jungle}.
Walk around @loc{Systarian Jungle} for the 20 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 20 quest pieces.
Return with the @item{Jet Wings}, @item{Paint Wand}, @item{Tractor Beam}, @item{Grapple Gun} and @item{Welding Tool}; several quests open only after you beat the boss.

achievements.summary: Finish the Harmony City story level.

steps.text: Follow the yellow star markers through the @loc{Harmony City} story until the level ends.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces in Harmony City
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in Harmony City, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Harmony City} holds about 50 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 10 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Harmony City}.
Walk around @loc{Harmony City} for the 26 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 14 quest pieces.
Photograph Aquaman and The Flash for their follow-up quests and open the Sun to reach one of the pieces.

achievements.summary: Finish the Sorting Area story level.

steps.text: Follow the yellow star markers through the @loc{Sorting Area} story until the level ends.
Play the @loc{Sorting Area} story to its end and defeat the @enemy{Sortapus}.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces in the Sorting Area
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in the Sorting Area, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Sorting Area} holds about 50 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 11 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Sorting Area}.
Walk around @loc{Sorting Area} for the 19 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 20 quest pieces.
Return with the @item{Grapple Gun} for the crate beside the shop and the @item{Tractor Beam} for the statue quest.

achievements.displayName: There ain't nothing you can’t break!

steps.text: Follow the yellow star markers through the @loc{The Ceremony} story until the level ends.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces in The Ceremony
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in The Ceremony, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{The Ceremony} holds about 50 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 5 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{The Ceremony}.
Walk around @loc{The Ceremony} for the 30 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 15 quest pieces.

Bring the @item{Jet Wings} for the many high pieces, such as the Forge girder, the music stage and the cake, and switch to an animal character such as Timmy Terrier, sold in the shop, to speak to the dalmatian.
Travel to the planet Classic Bricksburg from the planet map.
Follow the arrow through the story until the level ends.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces in Classic Bricksburg
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in Classic Bricksburg, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Classic Bricksburg} holds about 25 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 4 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Classic Bricksburg}.
Walk around @loc{Classic Bricksburg} for the 10 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 11 quest pieces.
Use @item{Danger Fists} on the Danger Brick wall for Lucy's quest, @item{Jet Wings} for the BRICKSBURG sign, and @item{Bouncers} for the Octan Tower door.
Travel to the planet The Old West from the planet map.
Follow the arrow through the story until the level ends.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces in the Old West
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in the Old West, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{The Old West} holds about 25 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 4 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{The Old West}.
Walk around @loc{The Old West} for the 14 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 7 quest pieces.
Smash the Danger Brick wall at the end of the train tracks with @item{Danger Fists} and fly to the water tower with the @item{Jet Wings}.

achievements.displayName: One King to Rule Them All

steps.text: Travel to the planet Middle Zealand from the planet map.
Follow the arrow through the story until the level ends.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces in Middle Zealand
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in Middle Zealand, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Middle Zealand} holds about 25 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 4 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Middle Zealand}.
Walk around @loc{Middle Zealand} for the 15 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 6 quest pieces.
Finish the King's Thing of Power quest by going through Sir Stack-A-Brick and the Night Lord's Castle.

achievements.displayName: The Opposite of the Opposite of Happiness!

steps.text: Travel to the planet Unikitty from the planet map.
Follow the arrow through the story until the level ends.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces on Planet Unikitty
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in Planet Unikitty, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Planet Unikitty} holds about 25 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 4 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Planet Unikitty}.
Walk around @loc{Planet Unikitty} for the 15 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 6 quest pieces.
Buy Giraffe Man and a banana at the shop for two quests, and pick the apple from the nearby tree.
Travel to the planet Sparkles from the planet map.
Follow the arrow through the story until the level ends.

achievements.description: Collect all Master Pieces on Planet Sparkles
achievements.summary: Collect every Master Piece in Planet Sparkles, whether story, found or quest.

guide.context: @loc{Planet Sparkles} holds about 29 Master Pieces. The @item{Super Map} item shows pieces you have missed.

steps.text: Collect the 5 story pieces by following the yellow star markers through @loc{Planet Sparkles}.
Walk around @loc{Planet Sparkles} for the 13 found pieces, which sit hidden in the world.
Speak to every character with a grey question mark above them for the 11 quest pieces.
Smash the green crystals for Superman, and check the southwest and southeast ledges on the upper level.
Complete the story levels in order until the last one, @loc{The Ceremony}, ends.

achievements.summary: Unlock Lucy as a playable character.

steps.text: Keep playing the story; Lucy unlocks automatically.

achievements.summary: Unlock Rex as a playable character.

steps.text: Keep playing the story; Rex unlocks automatically, usually after the @loc{Apocalypseburg} boss.

achievements.summary: Unlock Unikitty as a playable character.

steps.text: Keep playing the story; Unikitty unlocks automatically, usually before the @loc{Systarian Jungle} boss.

achievements.summary: Unlock MetalBeard as a playable character.

steps.text: Keep playing the story; MetalBeard unlocks automatically, usually after the @loc{Systarian Jungle} boss.

achievements.displayName: I was talking to the spaceship...
achievements.summary: Unlock Benny as a playable character.

steps.text: Keep playing the story; Benny unlocks automatically, usually after MetalBeard joins you.

achievements.summary: Unlock Batman as a playable character.

steps.text: Keep playing the story; Batman unlocks automatically, usually after the @loc{Sorting Area} boss.

achievements.summary: Unlock Sweet Mayhem as a playable character.

steps.text: Keep playing the story; Sweet Mayhem unlocks automatically, usually near the end of the story.

guide.context: Gold variants exist for characters such as Batman, Benny, Emmet, General Mayhem, Lucy, MetalBeard, Rex and Unikitty. The character in each relic is random.

steps.text: Smash chests everywhere and open the relics they give.
If none has appeared, collect 400 @item{Master Pieces}, visit @loc{Goldtropolis}, and smash its chests; each holds a @item{Mega-Relic}.
Open the Mega-Relics until a character marked Gold, such as Batman (Gold) or Rex (Gold), appears.
Follow the story into @loc{Syspocalypstar} and finish the building tutorial.

guide.context: Buildings cost bricks, and only @loc{Syspocalypstar} lets you place them. This usually unlocks on its own when you finish the planet.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Syspocalypstar} and open the @item{Super Builder Page}.
Place buildings from the build menu, including the ones villagers ask for in their quests, until 20 are built.
Smash everything and open every chest while you play; this unlocks naturally during a full playthrough.
Smash a chest in the world when the story first points one out.

guide.context: Green relics hold three random items, and @item{Mega-Relics} also hold one.

steps.text: Open green relics and buy items in shops until you own 100.
If you are short after the story, buy everything affordable and smash chests in @loc{Goldtropolis} for more relics.

guide.context: Purple relics hold one random character, and @item{Mega-Relics} also hold one.

steps.text: Unlock story characters, then open purple relics and buy characters in shops.
If you are short after the story, smash chests in @loc{Goldtropolis} and open their relics for more characters.
Smash a chest, then open the relic it drops when the story first shows you how.
Open every relic you find through the story.
If you are short, smash chests in @loc{Goldtropolis}, where each chest holds relics.

achievements.description: Play as a Minidoll for the First Time

steps.text: In the character selection menu, choose one of the very thin LEGO Friends characters and play as them.
Walk to a shop when the story first shows one and buy any item.

guide.context: A duplicate @item{Super Item} gives a Super Relic Shard. @loc{Goldtropolis} chests give many relics.

steps.text: Keep opening relics until one holds something you already own.
Play the story; the game introduces the build attack, and the achievement unlocks the first time you perform it.

guide.context: Master Pieces make up the main requirement. Whether relic items also count is not confirmed.

steps.text: Collect every @item{Master Piece} in all worlds, including @loc{Syspocalypstar}, the five bonus planets and the story worlds.
After 400 @item{Master Pieces}, visit @loc{Goldtropolis} and take its ten pieces.
Smash everything and open every chest; studs add up over a full playthrough.

achievements.description: Shoot 50 Stickers with the Sticker Gun
achievements.summary: Fire a total of 50 stickers from the Sticker Gun.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Sticker Gun} and pick a sticker.
Fire stickers at a wall until you have shot 50.

achievements.description: Try and place an object somewhere you can't, while on Syspocalypstar.
achievements.summary: Try to place a build somewhere it cannot go on Syspocalypstar.

steps.text: On @loc{Syspocalypstar}, choose any build to place.
Aim it at a wall; wait until its outline turns red, then try to place it.
